rules.description: One row per grain (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period) — no duplicates
rules.sql: SELECT cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM base.conformed_facts GROUP BY cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
rules.rationale: EDA confirms 28,849 unique grains with zero duplicates at (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period). conformed_id is a deterministic hash of this grain — any duplicate indicates a collision resolution or write bug. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 6.

rules.description: conformed_id is unique across all rows
rules.sql: SELECT conformed_id, COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts GROUP BY conformed_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
rules.rationale: conformed_id is a SHA-256 hash of the grain (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period). Duplicates mean either a hash collision (astronomically unlikely) or a write bug. Source: spec section 3.1.

rules.description: Every source_fact_id exists in base.financial_facts
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts cf WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base.financial_facts ff WHERE ff.fact_id = cf.source_fact_id)
rules.rationale: source_fact_id is the FK linking conformed facts to the winning fact in financial_facts. Orphan references break lineage traceability (conformed → financial_facts → SEC filing). Source: spec section 2.5, EDA Section 12 threshold recommendations.

rules.description: All 20 in-scope companies are represented
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cik) FROM base.conformed_facts
rules.rationale: EDA confirms all 20 companies present in filtered output. Losing even one company indicates a filtering or join bug. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 10 (20 distinct CIKs).

rules.description: All 25 business terms are represented
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_term_id) FROM base.conformed_facts
rules.rationale: EDA confirms all 25 business terms present (BT-022 through BT-048). Missing a business term means the filtering or collision resolution dropped an entire term. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 10.

rules.description: No NULL values in required columns
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE conformed_id IS NULL OR source_fact_id IS NULL OR entity_id IS NULL OR cik IS NULL OR canonical_name IS NULL OR business_term_id IS NULL OR business_term IS NULL OR financial_statement IS NULL OR category IS NULL OR source_concept IS NULL OR val IS NULL OR unit IS NULL OR fiscal_year IS NULL OR fiscal_period IS NULL OR period_end_date IS NULL OR calendar_year IS NULL OR calendar_quarter IS NULL OR accession_number IS NULL OR filed_date IS NULL OR competing_fact_count IS NULL OR selection_reason IS NULL OR promoted_at IS NULL OR load_date IS NULL
rules.rationale: EDA shows 0 NULL vals in the filtered output set. All columns marked 'Required=Yes' in the spec (section 3.1) must be populated. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 11 (0 NULL values).

rules.description: val in conformed_facts matches val in financial_facts for the referenced source_fact_id
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts cf JOIN base.financial_facts ff ON cf.source_fact_id = ff.fact_id WHERE cf.val != ff.val
rules.rationale: The conformed_facts value must be an exact copy of the winning fact's value — no transformation is applied to val during collision resolution. Any mismatch indicates a write bug or join error. Source: spec section 2.2 (logic moves values as-is), EDA threshold recommendations.

rules.description: competing_fact_count is >= 1 for all rows
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE competing_fact_count < 1
rules.rationale: Every conformed fact must have at least 1 competing fact (itself). A value of 0 indicates a logic bug in the collision counting. EDA confirms 100% of grains have competing_fact_count >= 1 (51% sole_candidate + 49% collision). Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 6.

rules.description: selection_reason is one of the three valid enum values
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE selection_reason NOT IN ('sole_candidate', 'primary_concept', 'tier_frequency_fallback')
rules.rationale: Spec defines exactly three selection reasons (section 2.5). EDA confirms the distribution: 51.0% sole_candidate, 46.77% primary_concept, 2.24% tier_frequency_fallback. Any other value is a bug. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 8.

rules.description: sole_candidate selection_reason only when competing_fact_count = 1, and vice versa
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE (selection_reason = 'sole_candidate' AND competing_fact_count != 1) OR (competing_fact_count = 1 AND selection_reason != 'sole_candidate')
rules.rationale: EDA cross-field analysis: when competing_fact_count = 1, selection_reason must be sole_candidate; when > 1, it must be primary_concept or tier_frequency_fallback. These are structurally coupled. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Cross-Field Analysis item 1.

rules.description: Per-share business terms (BT-044, BT-045, BT-046) have unit = 'USD/shares'; all others have unit = 'USD'
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE (business_term_id IN ('BT-044', 'BT-045', 'BT-046') AND unit != 'USD/shares') OR (business_term_id NOT IN ('BT-044', 'BT-045', 'BT-046') AND unit != 'USD')
rules.rationale: EDA cross-field analysis: after unit filtering, per-share terms (EPS Basic, EPS Diluted, Dividends/Share) must have USD/shares and all other BTs must have USD. The filtering pipeline enforces this but post-write validation is required. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Cross-Field Analysis item 2, Section 5.

rules.description: Row count within expected range (25,000 to 35,000)
rules.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 25000 AND COUNT(*) <= 35000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM base.conformed_facts
rules.rationale: EDA produces 28,849 grains. Range of 25,000-35,000 allows for moderate data growth/contraction while catching catastrophic data loss or explosion. The lower bound prevents >14% shrinkage; the upper bound prevents >21% growth without investigation. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 9, threshold recommendations.

rules.description: Every company has at least 15 business terms
rules.sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(DISTINCT business_term_id) AS bt_count FROM base.conformed_facts GROUP BY cik HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT business_term_id) < 15
rules.rationale: EDA shows the minimum is 17/25 terms (JPMorgan, Berkshire — financial sector). Threshold of 15 gives a 2-term buffer below the observed minimum while still catching major coverage drops. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 10.

rules.description: fiscal_period is a valid value (FY, Q1, Q2, Q3)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE fiscal_period NOT IN ('FY', 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3')
rules.rationale: EDA Section 11 shows the only fiscal_period values are FY, Q1, Q2, Q3. Any other value would indicate a filtering or derivation bug.

rules.description: calendar_quarter is between 1 and 4
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE calendar_quarter < 1 OR calendar_quarter > 4
rules.rationale: Calendar quarter must be 1-4. Consistent with BASE-FM-005 on the source table. Source: inherited structural constraint.

rules.description: Fiscal year range is within expected bounds (min <= 2010, max >= current_year - 1)
rules.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(fiscal_year) <= 2010 AND MAX(fiscal_year) >= 2025 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM base.conformed_facts
rules.rationale: EDA shows fiscal_year range 2006-2026. XBRL adoption was mandatory by 2009; we should have data back to at least 2010. The latest year should be at least 2025 (current_year - 1). Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 11.

rules.description: promoted_at is within the last 7 days (pipeline recency check)
rules.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(promoted_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM base.conformed_facts
rules.rationale: Per governance-reviewer advisory, freshness rules verify the table was recently promoted. A 7-day window is appropriate for a batch pipeline that runs on-demand during development. This threshold should be tightened to 24-48 hours once the pipeline is on a regular schedule.

rules.description: selection_reason distribution is within expected ranges
rules.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN sole_pct >= 40.0 AND sole_pct <= 65.0 AND primary_pct >= 30.0 AND primary_pct <= 55.0 AND fallback_pct <= 10.0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN selection_reason = 'sole_candidate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS sole_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN selection_reason = 'primary_concept' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS primary_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN selection_reason = 'tier_frequency_fallback' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS fallback_pct FROM base.conformed_facts)
rules.rationale: EDA shows 51.0% sole_candidate, 46.77% primary_concept, 2.24% tier_frequency_fallback. Ranges allow for moderate drift: sole_candidate 40-65%, primary_concept 30-55%, fallback <= 10%. A shift beyond these bounds indicates a change in collision resolution behavior that warrants investigation. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 8.

rules.description: No superseded facts leak into conformed_facts
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts cf JOIN base.financial_facts ff ON cf.source_fact_id = ff.fact_id WHERE ff.is_superseded = true
rules.rationale: The conformed_facts pipeline filters out all superseded facts (49.3% of source table). Any superseded fact appearing here means the filter is broken. This is a structural constraint. Source: base-conformed-facts-eda.md Section 2 (269,962 superseded facts removed).

rules.description: Revenue (BT-022) should be positive for non-financial companies
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE business_term_id = 'BT-022' AND val < 0 AND cik NOT IN (19617, 886982, 1067983, 1403161)
rules.rationale: EDA: 1,326/1,329 Revenue values (99.77%) are positive. 3 negative values exist: Apple ($-29M), Microsoft ($-6B), Goldman Sachs ($-4.7B). Goldman Sachs excluded as financial. Apple and Microsoft negatives are legitimate quarterly adjustments (revenue reclassifications). Threshold set to <= 2 to accommodate these known cases. Growth beyond 2 would indicate a new data issue. Financial CIKs excluded: JPM (19617), GS (886982), BRK (1067983), Visa (1403161).

rules.description: Total Assets (BT-024) must be positive
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE business_term_id = 'BT-024' AND val <= 0
rules.rationale: EDA: All 1,298 Total Assets values are positive (100%). Zero or negative total assets is definitionally impossible for a going concern. This is a hard constraint regardless of sector.

rules.description: Per-share metrics (BT-044, BT-045, BT-046) magnitude < 10,000
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE business_term_id IN ('BT-044', 'BT-045', 'BT-046') AND ABS(val) >= 10000
rules.rationale: EDA: BT-044 (EPS Basic) ranges from -$20.88 to $5,265 — the high end is Berkshire Hathaway Class A shares (legitimate). BT-045 (EPS Diluted) ranges from -$20.88 to $59.45. BT-046 (DPS) ranges from $0 to $14. Threshold of 10,000 accommodates Berkshire's Class A EPS ($5,265 max observed) with a 90% buffer while catching unit-filtering bugs that would produce billion-dollar EPS values.

rules.description: USD metrics magnitude should be < 10 trillion
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE unit = 'USD' AND ABS(val) >= 10000000000000
rules.rationale: EDA: The largest absolute USD value is $4.56 trillion (Total Assets, likely JPMorgan or Berkshire). No single company metric has ever exceeded $10T. Values beyond this threshold indicate unit/scale errors (e.g., reporting in cents instead of dollars). The 10T bound gives a 2.2x buffer over the observed maximum.

rules.description: Each company's metrics for a given period should come from <= 4 distinct accession numbers
rules.sql: SELECT cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, COUNT(DISTINCT accession_number) AS acc_cnt FROM base.conformed_facts GROUP BY cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accession_number) > 4
rules.rationale: EDA: Distribution is 218 groups with 1 accession, 931 with 2, 220 with 3, and 45 with 4. Spec proposed <= 3 but real data shows 45 legitimate groups with 4 accessions (e.g., Boeing FY2011, JPMorgan FY2018). Threshold adjusted to <= 4 to avoid false positives. >4 would indicate collision resolution drew from too many source filings.

rules.description: No superseded facts in conformed_facts (source fact must not be superseded)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts cf JOIN base.financial_facts ff ON cf.source_fact_id = ff.fact_id WHERE ff.is_superseded = true
rules.rationale: EDA: 0 superseded facts found in conformed_facts (verified via join to financial_facts). Supersession filter is the first pipeline step — 269,962 superseded facts (49.3% of source) must be excluded. If even one leaks through, the entire conformation is suspect. Complements BASE-CF-019 (Completeness) with an explicit Accuracy dimension check.

rules.description: No null business_term_id values in conformed_facts
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE business_term_id IS NULL
rules.rationale: EDA: 0 null business_term_id values found. The conformation pipeline filters out facts that don't map to a business term. Null BT leakage means unmapped XBRL concepts pollute the conformed table, breaking all downstream joins and aggregations.

rules.description: No facts with wrong unit per business term (USD for dollar metrics, USD/shares for per-share)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts WHERE (business_term_id IN ('BT-044', 'BT-045', 'BT-046') AND unit != 'USD/shares') OR (business_term_id NOT IN ('BT-044', 'BT-045', 'BT-046') AND unit != 'USD')
rules.rationale: EDA: All 25 business terms have exactly 1 distinct unit each — per-share terms (BT-044, 045, 046) use USD/shares, all others use USD. Zero violations found. A wrong-unit value (e.g., USD/shares on a Revenue metric) would produce magnitudes off by orders of magnitude. Complements BASE-CF-011 (Consistency) with an explicit Accuracy dimension check.
